text_original: After six months the motor died. Support replied but told me to open the machine and replace the motor myself.
text_translated: 用了六个月电机坏了。客服回复了，但让我自己拆机换电机。

text_original: I emailed four times over two weeks. Every answer was an automated reply. No human ever contacted me.
text_translated: 两周内我发了四封邮件，每封都是自动回复，没有任何真人联系我。

text_original: There is no tracking number and the status page has not changed for ten days. I have no idea where the parcel is.
text_translated: 没有物流单号，状态页十天没更新，我完全不知道包裹在哪。

gold_groups.l1: 物流状态无法跟踪/感知

text_original: I sent the machine back with the return label they gave me. Now they claim it never arrived and refuse the refund.
text_translated: 我用他们给的退货标签把机器寄回去了，现在他们说没收到，拒绝退款。
